jobs.title: Data Analyst II - Commercial & Medical Analytics
jobs.description:
Rezolute is a late-stage rare disease biopharmaceutical company focused on developing transformative therapies for patients living with severe metabolic and endocrine disorders. Our mission is to bring hope and meaningful solutions to patients and families affected by rare and difficult-to-treat diseases through scientific innovation, collaboration, and integrity.

Rezolute’s lead investigational therapy, RZ358 (ersodetug), is a fully human monoclonal antibody in late-stage clinical development for the treatment of hypoglycemia due to congenital and acquired forms of hyperinsulinism (HI). As Rezolute expands its medical and scientific focus into tumor-related hyperinsulinism (tumor HI),
most commonly related to pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors (insulinomas) or paraneoplastic hypoglycemia (NICTH), the company is committed to advancing novel therapeutic strategies that address this rare and complex form of hypoglycemia associated with insulin-secreting tumors and related neuro-oncology disorders.

More information can be found at rezolutebio.com

Position Summary

Rezolute is seeking a Data Analyst II to turn complex data into actionable insights supporting commercial planning, medical affairs, and business decision-making. This hands-on role combines data management, coding, analysis, and visualization to help teams better understand patient populations, healthcare providers, treatment patterns, and market opportunities.

The Data Analyst II will use AWS, Snowflake, SQL, and Python or R to integrate data, automate analytical workflows, and develop reliable datasets and reporting solutions. Working closely with business stakeholders, this individual will translate questions into structured analyses and communicate findings through clear visualizations, reports, and presentations.

The ideal candidate brings strong technical skills, sound analytical judgment, and a collaborative, self-directed approach. Experience with healthcare claims or other pharmaceutical industry data is a plus.

Key Responsibilities

Acquire, clean, integrate, and manage healthcare and business data using AWS, Snowflake, SQL, and Python or R.
Build, deploy, and maintain reusable data pipelines, analytical datasets, and scheduled code in AWS and Snowflake.
Develop a strong working knowledge of healthcare data and the biopharmaceutical industry, including how claims, provider, and market data reflect patient care and business activity.
Conduct exploratory and statistical analyses to identify trends, answer business questions, and generate actionable insights.
Apply statistical and machine learning methods, where appropriate, to support patient identification, segmentation, and prioritization, with clear documentation of methods, validation, and limitations.
Support analyses of patient populations, healthcare providers and organizations, treatment patterns, market dynamics, and field-team activity.
Develop dashboards, reports, and visualizations in Power BI, Tableau, Python, or comparable tools.
Automate recurring data preparation, quality checks, and reporting processes to reduce manual effort.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree with a minimum of 3 years' experience in a quantitative or technical field, such as statistics, mathematics, economics, computer science, or engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
Relevant professional experience in data analytics, data management, analytics engineering, or a related field.
Hands-on experience with AWS and Snowflake for data storage, querying, transformation, or analytical workflows.
Strong SQL skills and proficiency in Python or R for data manipulation, analysis, and automation.
Experience cleaning, combining, and analyzing large or complex datasets.
Proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint for analysis and communication.
Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with others.

Preferred Attributes

Experience with Databricks, Snowflake or Azure in addition to AWS.
Familiarity with JavaScript frontend frameworks or Python application frameworks.
Experience supporting cloud migrations, workflow automation, or data platform modernization.
Experience using company-approved AI-enabled tools for coding, testing, or documentation, with appropriate attention to security and output validation.

Rezolute (RZLT) currently anticipates the base salary for the Data Analyst II, Commercial & Medical Analytics role could range from $ 110,000 to $140,000
and will depend, in part, on the successful candidate’s geographical location and their qualifications for the role, including education and experience. This position will also be eligible for an annual performance bonus in accordance with the terms of the applicable plan (depending, in part, on company and individual performance and at the Company’s discretion on an individual basis). The compensation described above is subject to change and could be higher or lower than the range described based on current market survey data and the qualifications, education, experience and geographical location of the selected candidate.

Health Insurance (Medical / Dental / Vision)

Holiday Pay

jobs.title: Manufacturing Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Your Job

Molex is seeking a Manufacturing Data Analyst to turn production data into accurate, actionable information that helps our manufacturing leaders make better decisions. This role builds and maintains the reports, dashboards, and metrics that show how our operations are performing, and digs into the data to find opportunities to improve safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, and capacity. This is not a desk-only analytics role: you will spend time on the production floor observing processes, validating data, and conducting time studies alongside Manufacturing and Engineering teams.

Our Team

You will support our Manufacturing Operations and Manufacturing Engineering teams in an on-site, regulated manufacturing environment. Working closely with Quality, Planning, and other functions, our team relies on timely, trustworthy data to improve visibility into production performance and drive continuous improvement.

What You Will Do

Create and own the daily, weekly, and monthly reports, dashboards, and KPIs that give manufacturing leadership a clear view of production performance.
Analyze productivity, throughput, cycle time, labor utilization, capacity, schedule attainment, quality, and delivery to uncover trends, bottlenecks, and improvement opportunities.
Get on the production floor to conduct time studies, cycle-time measurements, and workflow observations that support labor standards and capacity planning.
Safeguard data integrity by validating manufacturing data and investigating discrepancies between production records, reports, and systems.
Reduce manual effort by developing reporting tools and automating data collection and reporting activities.
Partner with Manufacturing Engineering on Travelers, work instructions, process records, and data collection tools.
Serve as a go-to resource for manufacturing software, internal applications, and production label systems, troubleshooting issues and helping implement improvements.
Provide the data and analysis behind continuous improvement projects and measure the results after implementation.

Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)

High school diploma or equivalent with experience in a manufacturing, operations, or engineering environment, OR an Associate degree in Engineering Technology, Manufacturing Technology, Data Analytics, Business, Information Systems, or a related technical field.
Experience using Microsoft Office tools, including Excel.
Ability to work on-site and spend regular time on the production floor.

What Will Put You Ahead

2+ years of experience supporting manufacturing, operations, engineering, production reporting, or data analysis.
Experience using Microsoft Excel formulas, lookups, and PivotTables to analyze data and develop reports.
Experience with ERP/MRP systems such as SAP.
Experience with Power BI, SQL, Snowflake, or similar data and visualization tools.
Experience with programming languages such as Python, Java, or PHP.
Experience with barcode and manufacturing label systems.
Experience in electronics, aerospace, defense, or other regulated manufacturing environments.

In order to comply with U.S. export control laws and regulations, this position requires applicants to either provide proof of U.S. citizenship or lawful permanent resident status or be eligible to receive an export authorization (a license) under the International Traffic in Arms Regulations and/or the Export Administration Regulations.

For this role, we anticipate paying $25.00 - $30.00 per hour.

At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy.

As a Koch company, Molex is a leading supplier of connectors and interconnect components, driving innovation in electronics and supporting industries from automotive to health care and consumer to data communications. The thousands of innovators who work for Molex have made us a global electronics leader. Our experienced people, groundbreaking products and leading-edge technologies help us deliver a wider array of solutions to more markets than ever before.

jobs.title: Staff Research Associate 1
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Founded in 1965, UC Irvine
is a member of the prestigious Association of American Universities and is ranked among the nation’s top 10 public universities by U.S. News & World Report. The campus has produced five Nobel laureates and is known for its academic achievement, premier research, innovation and anteater mascot. Led by Chancellor Howard Gillman, UC Irvine has more than 36,000 students and offers 224 degree programs. It’s located in one of the world’s safest and most economically vibrant communities and is Orange County’s second-largest employer, contributing $7 billion annually to the local economy and $8 billion statewide.

To learn more about UC Irvine, visit www.uci.edu.

The UC Irvine Institute for Memory Impairments and Neurological Disorders (UCI MIND) Orange County's only state and federally funded Alzheimer's Disease Research Center and is internationally recognized for its research accomplishments in age-related brain disorders. The Institute is composed of faculty and staff from multiple Departments and Schools, ranging from basic laboratory scientists to physician investigators, with a common goal of research discovery to improve the diagnosis, treatment, prevention, and cure of age-related brain diseases, especially Alzheimer's disease.

For more than 30 years, UCI MIND has been at the forefront of Alzheimer's disease research. It is home to one of 37 Alzheimer's Disease Research Centers (ADRC) funded by the National Institute on Aging (NIA), a branch of the National Institutes of Health (NIH), and one of 10 California Alzheimer's Disease Centers funded by the California Department of Public Health.

To learn more about UCI MIND, visit mind.uci.edu.

Your Role on the Team

Under the direction of Dr. Joshua Grill in the Institute of Memory Impairments and Neurological Disorders (UCI MIND), the Staff Research Associate 1 (SRA 1) will assist in the conduct of several research studies related to the science of recruitment. The mission of the Grill Lab is to 1) improve Alzheimer's disease (AD) clinical trial design, 2) elucidate barriers to AD clinical trial enrollment, 3) better understand AD trial participant retention strategies, and 4) investigate the ethical challenges specific to AD trials. The SRA 1 will be responsible for conducting mixed methods research with participants from varied cultural backgrounds. They will be asked to collect, translate, transcribe and enter data. The SRA 1 will help organize community and university events to promote the mission of UCI MIND and give talks and participate in various outreach events. They will assist in the recruitment and enrollment of participants to various research projects.

Required

What It Takes to be Successful

Highly motivated and service-oriented with strong interpersonal and communication skills, able to communicate clearly and tactfully with a broad variety of people both verbally and in writing.
Proven ability to function effectively as a team member and follow detailed directions.
Skill to operate Macintosh and PC platform, and skill to use Word, Excel, Access and Adobe Acrobat.
Skill in maintaining a well-organized and professional workplace.
Ability to manage multiple projects in different stages of development at the same time.
A minimum of 1 year of experienceIncumbents are expected to possess the skills, knowledge, and abilities essential to the successful performance of the duties assigned to the positions. These skills, knowledge, and abilities are typically acquired through a combination of extensive study and experience.

Preferred

Ability to speak publicly to large audiences about brain health and neurodegenerative diseases.
Experience working in human research and interview based observational studies.
Fluency in English and one of the following languages; Spanish, Mandarin, Vietnamese or Korean
Experience in REDCap, and CanvaPro
Valid driver’s license and ability to travel by car to various locations around Orange County
Bachelor's degree and/or equivalent years’ experience in neuroscience, biology, psychology or similar related field.

Special Conditions

Ability to travel by car to various locations around Orange County.

Total Rewards

In addition to the salary range listed below, we offer a wealth of benefits to make working at UCI even more rewarding. These benefits may include medical insurance, sick and vacation time, retirement savings plans, and access to a number of discounts and perks. Please utilize the links listed here to learn more about our compensation practices and benefits.

The expected pay range for this recruitment is $29.99- $31.95 (Hourly).

jobs.title: Laboratory Technician, Microbiology Culture Set-up
jobs.description:
As a Medical Laboratory Technician (MLT)
in the Microbiology Culture-Set department at IDEXX, you will be a key contributor at one of the largest veterinary diagnostic companies in the world. You will perform laboratory testing that helps veterinarians diagnose and treat pets. You will join a fast-paced work environment that encourages teamwork, quality, and offers opportunities for personal growth. This is a full-time role with competitive benefits.

IDEXX reference laboratories is a global network united by a shared commitment to enhancing pet care where the true strength in our name is the people behind it. Our reference laboratories make it possible for our customers to discover more with our unrelenting commitment to innovation, personalized support, guidance, and expertise, while providing the most complete and advanced menu of diagnostic tests along with technology and tools.

In This Role

You will be using automated analyzers, microscopes and other laboratory diagnostic tools to perform analyses and tests that diagnose animal illnesses, injuries and diseases in support of veterinarian animal treatment. 
You will be performing diagnostic tests on blood, urine, fecal, or pet biopsy samples that we receive in our lab by the thousands, every day.
You will be responsible for setting up and running lab tests and reading and releasing results according to SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures).
You can expect to specialize in one or more of the following areas:  

Microbiology: Processing clinical samples for the identification

of bacteria and fungi using automated and manual methods. 

What You Will Need To Succeed

Ideally, you will have experience working in a laboratory. Experience setting up, running, and reading lab tests, and operating laboratory equipment (microscopes and/or clinical diagnostic analyzers) would be a plus.
You have a positive attitude and love to bring that energy into the lab every day to support your colleagues
You are looking forward to working in a team
You concentrate on the details and can work reliably and precisely
You have a great sense of team spirit and responsibility
You possess a High School diploma or equivalent combination of education and experience is required. A 2-, 3- or 4-year degree in a Science-related field is preferred.
It is not required to work in our lab, but if you were a Veterinary Technician (RVT, LVT, CVT) or Medical Laboratory Technician (MLT or MT), this experience and education would be a plus.
Able to meet the physical requirements that go with working in a lab – standing and sitting for extended periods of time, phone & computer use, extended reach, lifting up to 50lb, and specific vision ability – close, color, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
This is a laboratory, so there is potential exposure to biohazards, agents known to cause zoonotic diseases, and hazardous chemicals.

Schedule

This is a full-time (40 hr/wk), day-shift position, with scheduled shifts Tuesday - Saturday, hours TBD (flexibility is a plus!)
This is a busy time of year in the lab, so you may be asked to stay until the work is complete.
The shifts and hours may vary slightly depending on business needs.
Reliable and dependable attendance is an essential function of the position.

Why IDEXX?

We’re proud of the work we do, because our work matters. An innovation leader in every industry we serve, we follow our Purpose and Guiding Principles to help pet owners worldwide keep their companion animals healthy and happy, to ensure safe drinking water for billions, and to help farmers protect livestock and poultry from disease. We have customers in over 175 countries and a global workforce of over 10,000 talented people.

So, what does that mean for you? We enrich the livelihoods of our employees with a positive and respectful work culture that embraces challenges and encourages learning and discovery. At IDEXX, you will be supported by competitive compensation, incentives, and benefits while enjoying purposeful work that drives improvement.

Let’s pursue what matters together.

IDEXX values a diverse workforce and workplace and strongly encourages women, people of color, LGBTQ+ individuals, people with disabilities, members of ethnic minorities, foreign-born residents, and veterans to apply.

IDEXX is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will not be discriminated against because of race, color, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, citizenship status, disability, ancestry, marital status, veteran status, medical condition, or any protected category prohibited by local, state, or federal laws.

This position will be based out of our West Sacramento, CA location.

jobs.title: Laboratory Technician I (M-F, 3pm -11:30pm) Eurofins Environment Testing Northern California - Air Toxics, Folsom, CA
jobs.description:
Company Description

Eurofins Scientific is a network of independent companies providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic, and labelling is accurate.

Eurofins is dedicated to delivering testing services that contribute to the health and safety of society and the planet, and to its corporate responsibility to protect the environment and ensure diversity, equity, and inclusion across the entire network of Eurofins companies.

With over 50 laboratories and more than 40 service centers nationwide, Eurofins Environment Testing provides full-service environmental analysis across all 50 states. Our network supports public and private clients—including DoD, DOE, and municipalities—through robust logistics and continuous investment in people, technology, and infrastructure.

We offer comprehensive testing for air, water, soil, sediment, tissue, and waste, covering a wide range of analytes including PFAS, metals, VOCs/SVOCs, dioxins/furans, radiochemicals, and more.

Job Description

Eurofins Environment Testing Northern California - Air Toxics is looking for a Laboratory Technician I to join our Folsom, CA team.

Duties And Responsibilities

Prepare samples for analysis in accordance with applicable Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), analytical methods, client requirements, and internal procedures.
Pressurize, screen, and otherwise prepare samples as required for analytical testing.
Perform routine laboratory support activities and assist analysts with sample handling, preparation, and other analytical needs.
Serve as a laboratory runner, transporting samples, standards, supplies, paperwork, and other materials throughout the laboratory as needed.
Perform administrative and clerical tasks associated with laboratory operations, including documentation, data entry, sample tracking, and record maintenance.
Read, understand, and accurately follow SOPs, Air Toxics methods, client requirements, and internal procedures.
Ensure all sample preparation, documentation, data handling, and laboratory activities are completed accurately and in accordance with applicable procedures.
Prepare calibration standards and other materials required for analytical testing.
Operate and utilize the Air Toxics LIMS system for sample tracking, documentation, data entry, and other applicable laboratory functions.
Maintain accurate and complete records of work performed and ensure documentation is completed in a timely manner.
Assist analytical personnel with routine laboratory tasks and provide support as needed to maintain efficient workflow.
Monitor sample and workload status and communicate production, quality, equipment, or sample-related issues to management.
Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area in accordance with laboratory safety requirements.
Demonstrate accuracy, attention to detail, and consistency when handling samples, documentation, and laboratory materials.
Demonstrate effective written and verbal communication skills.
Prioritize and manage multiple assignments while meeting established deadlines and turnaround requirements.
Demonstrate and promote the company's vision, values, quality standards, and commitment to customer service.
Perform other laboratory, administrative, and support duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Minimum Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree Is Preferred But Not Required.

Experience working in a fast paced environment similar to food service or production setting.

Ability And/or Skills

Adherence to safety protocol and operation procedures; Excellent customer service; resourceful and collaborative approach in solving problems; function in an environment of constant change and conflicting priorities; communicate well with coworkers and management; read, understand and comply with SOPs; concentrate, focus, and be attentive to details; use a keyboard to enter data; work under medium to high stress level; ability to exercise independent judgment and effectively use resources to solve problems; ability to lift up to 25 pounds on a continuous basis, stand for prolonged periods; work upright, bend and use hands and arms repetitively to perform moderate physical work duties; the ability to push carts with objects on board weighing up to 50 pounds; hearing and speaking are needed to listen effectively and talk with individuals in person or on the phone; specific vision abilities required by this job include; close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

Hazardous Material Handling

The Eurofins Air Toxics laboratory houses chemicals necessary for the analysis of various environmental samples. These chemicals can be harmful if not properly handled. The list includes but is not limited to; cryogenic Dewars of liquid nitrogen, compressed gasses including helium, nitrogen and hydrogen, sharps and liquid solvents such as methylene chloride, acetonitrile and acetone. This position requires the ability to safely handle and transport these bulk chemicals. The employee will be required to read and reference the Chemical Hygiene Plan and Injury and Illness Prevention Program for additional information and instruction.

Additional Information

Compensation Range
: $19 - $21 per hour depending on experience and qualifications.

Position is full-time and non-exempt from overtime pay, candidates must be able to work the following shift:

Monday - Friday, 3:00pm - 11:30pm

Weekends and overtime as needed.

Eurofins Environment Testing (USA) provides a compensation range for informational purposes, the actual base compensation may vary based upon, but not limited to, relevant experience and skill set, base compensation of internal peers, business sector, and geographic location.

We offer excellent full-time benefits including comprehensive medical coverage, life and disability insurance, 401(k) with company match, paid holidays and vacation, personal days, and dental and vision options.

We support your development!
Do you feel you don’t match 100% of the requirements? Don’t hesitate to apply anyway! Eurofins companies are committed to supporting your career development.

We embrace diversity!
Eurofins network of companies believe in strength and innovation through diversity, being an Equal Opportunity Employer. We prohibit discrimination against employees or applications based on gender identity and/or expression, race, nationality, age, religion, sexual orientation, disability, and everything else that makes employees of Eurofins companies unique.

Sustainability matters to us!
At Eurofins, we believe sustainability is at the heart of everything we do. Guided by our vision to be the Global Leader in “Testing for Life,” our mission to contribute to a healthier and safer world, and our core values, we are building a strong foundation for Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives. Eurofins’ commitment to sustainability begins within our own companies through a shared responsibility to people and the planet. With climate change posing an imminent threat, Eurofins and its many companies recognize their duty to proactively reduce or offset the environmental impact of essential operations while also helping our clients do the same—serving as a true ESG Enabler.

Find out more in our career page: https://careers.eurofins.com/

Company description
: Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.

The Eurofins network of companies is the global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and agroscience contract research services. It is one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies, as well as having an emerging global presence in Contract Development and Manufacturing Organisations. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

In over 35 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to 61,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of ca. 900 laboratories in 61 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.

In 2025, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 7.296 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

jobs.title: Research Associate – Chemistry/Biochemistry
jobs.description:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

Working at Abbott

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You’ll also have access to :

Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
Free medical coverage for employees* via the Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO
An excellent retirement savings plan with high employer contribution
Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program and FreeU education benefit - an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree.
A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as a best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

The Opportunity

Abbott Rapid Diagnostics is seeking a highly motivated Research Associate II – Oligonucleotide Chemistry
to join our Research & Development team in San Diego, California.

In this role, you will contribute to the development of next-generation molecular diagnostic products by supporting the synthesis, purification, characterization, and evaluation of oligonucleotides used in diagnostic applications. You will work in a collaborative, fast-paced environment alongside scientists and engineers to deliver high-quality oligonucleotide reagents critical to assay and product development.

What You'll Work On

Synthesize DNA and RNA oligonucleotides using automated solid-phase oligonucleotide synthesizers.
Perform oligonucleotide cleavage, deprotection, desalting, and purification using established laboratory procedures.
Purify oligonucleotides using reverse-phase HPLC, ion-exchange chromatography, and cartridge-based purification platforms.
Characterize oligonucleotides using analytical techniques including HPLC, UV-Vis spectroscopy, LC-MS, and related methods.
Maintain detailed and accurate laboratory records, including synthesis documentation, analytical results, yields, and quality-control data.
Collaborate with assay development, product development, and cross-functional teams to provide oligonucleotide reagents and technical support.
Execute laboratory experiments, prepare samples, and assist in the evaluation of oligonucleotide performance in diagnostic applications.
Operate, maintain, and troubleshoot laboratory instrumentation and ensure compliance with laboratory safety and quality requirements.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Organic Chemistry, Molecular Biology, or a related scientific discipline.
1-4 years of industry or academic laboratory experience in oligonucleotide chemistry, nucleic acid technologies, or a related field.
Hands-on experience with oligonucleotide synthesis and post-synthesis processing techniques.
Familiarity with analytical characterization methods, including HPLC, UV-Vis spectroscopy, and mass spectrometry.
Strong organizational and documentation skills with the ability to maintain accurate laboratory records.
Demonstrated attention to detail and commitment to producing high-quality, reproducible data.
Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work effectively both independently and within multidisciplinary teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience operating automated oligonucleotide synthesizers such as MerMade, Dr. Oligo, or equivalent platforms.
Knowledge of solid-phase oligonucleotide synthesis and common probe and primer modifications.
Hands-on experience with fluorescently labeled oligonucleotides, quenchers, and other diagnostic probe chemistries.
Experience with post-synthetic oligonucleotide conjugation and modification techniques.
Familiarity with oligonucleotide purification using reverse-phase and ion-exchange chromatography methods.
Experience using chromatography systems such as Agilent or ÄKTA platforms.
Experience with LC-MS analysis and interpretation for oligonucleotide characterization.
Understanding of solid-phase organic synthesis principles and their application to nucleic acid chemistry.
Experience supporting molecular diagnostic, qPCR, or nucleic acid assay development programs.

jobs.title: Principal R&D Lab Technician
jobs.description:
At Capstan Medical, we're driven by an unwavering commitment to transforming the treatment of heart valve disease. By merging surgical robotics with catheter-based technology and next generation implants, we've pioneered a patient-optimized approach to repair and replace heart valves.

Our innovative technology offers a significantly less invasive alternative to traditional open-heart surgery while ensuring precise and reliable placement of the heart valve implant. With these advancements, we may be able to provide patients a solution to their heart valve disease while significantly reducing recovery time and minimizing the risk of complications. With a dedicated team of heart valve device experts and robotics engineers, we are fully committed to developing a comprehensive and transformative solution that will positively impact the lives of individuals affected by this condition.

Capstan Medical is uniquely positioned in Santa Cruz, giving us access to the amazing technical talent of the Bay Area in an environment that we feel is conducive to doing our best creative work. Our office is adjacent to large tracts of open space with bicycle trails straight from the office doors, offering access to the hills and beaches of Wilder Ranch State Park for road/mountain bicycle riding, hiking, and surfing.

Come join us and become part of a team revolutionizing heart valve treatment.

Description

Capstan Medical is seeking a Principal R&D Lab Technician to support the Implant team in the development and testing of next generation mitral and tricuspid valve replacements. This is a senior, hands-on individual contributor role that combines technical craft, such as valve sewing and assembly, with ownership of day-to-day laboratory operations and long-term test execution. The Principal Technician will be a trusted expert in the bench top lab, the DV testing environment, and the Accelerated Wear Testing (AWT) lab.

The ideal candidate is a highly detail-oriented, methodical problem solver with a scientific approach to troubleshooting and data collection. They bring deep hands-on experience with transcatheter heart valve prototypes and test equipment, communicate findings clearly, and can work independently with minimal supervision while collaborating closely with design engineers.

This role is an additional resource for the Implant team and is not a replacement for any existing team member's contributions to the lab. Following an initial three-month training period, the Principal Technician will help support the expansion of mitral valve sizes and tricuspid testing, and may grow into a broader test engineering role as the Implant program scales.

Responsibilities

Perform valve sewing and assembly of transcatheter heart valve implants and test articles to specification, maintaining consistent, high-quality workmanship across multiple device sizes
Support device preparation and preconditioning in the bench top lab, following approved protocols and documenting all activities accurately
Operate and maintain tensile test stands and execute tensile testing, including fixture setup, data collection, and basic analysis
Operate DV test equipment and execute associated test processes in support of design verification and regulatory submissions
Operate and maintain Accelerated Wear Testing (AWT) equipment to support long-term durability studies, ensuring continuous and reliable test execution and responding to equipment issues as they arise
Perform scanning electron microscopy (SEM) data collection, including sample preparation and image acquisition, in support of failure investigations and device characterization
Conduct implant inspections in accordance with internal standards, documenting observations clearly as part of the Design History Record (DHR)
Execute weekly equipment verification and, as applicable, support calibration, installation and operational qualification (IQ/OQ), and preventive maintenance to maintain quality system compliance
Manage lab resources, supplies, and consumables to keep the laboratory organized, well stocked, and fully operational
Collaborate with design engineers on new and existing implant test programs, providing hands-on testing support, feedback, and data interpretation
Assist with protocol development, data collection, and technical report preparation
Train and mentor less experienced technicians and interns on lab procedures, equipment operation, and assembly techniques

Qualifications

Minimum of 7 years of relevant experience in a medical device, cardiovascular, or comparable laboratory or assembly environment, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
Associate's or Bachelor's degree in engineering, biology, materials science, or a related technical field preferred. Extensive directly relevant hands-on experience may be considered in lieu of a degree
Demonstrated experience in valve sewing and assembly of transcatheter heart valves or comparable soft-goods or tissue-based implants
Hands-on experience supporting device preparation and preconditioning in a bench top lab environment
Tensile test stand experience, including fixture setup, operation, and data collection
Experience operating DV test equipment and executing DV test processes
AWT lab experience, including operation, monitoring, and troubleshooting of long-term durability test equipment
High attention to detail and a disciplined, scientific approach to problem solving
Proficiency in technical analysis and comfort organizing and interpreting quantitative test data
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to produce clear technical documentation and contribute to reports
Familiarity with laboratory quality practices, including equipment logs, calibration records, and standard operating procedures (SOPs)
Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and collaborate effectively in a cross-functional team environment

Preferred

Experience with scanning electron microscopy (SEM) or other materials characterization techniques
Exposure to regulated environments and quality management systems (e.g., ISO 13485, FDA 21 CFR Part 820)
Awareness of cardiovascular device testing standards such as ISO 5840
Experience with data analysis tools (e.g., Excel, MATLAB, Python)

As a Manufacturing Associate, you’ll produce custom oligonucleotide and gene-based products and intermediates in a highly automated, high-throughput molecular biology lab. You’ll follow established SOPs, complete manufacturing batch records, and help keep the daily production schedule on track. This role suits someone who is organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working independently in a fast-paced environment. You’ll uphold the standards of our manufacturing process, contribute to continuous improvement, manage your time well, and always work safely.

What You’ll Be Doing

Manufacture high-quality custom oligo products in a high-throughput manufacturing lab according to established SOPs
Operate robotic and traditional lab equipment, including bioanalyzers, centrifuges, sealers, thermocyclers, spectrometers, HPLCs, and next-generation sequencing instruments
Perform core molecular biology techniques daily, especially PCR, DNA quantitation and handling, and DNA purification
Maintain thorough, accurate documentation of all work in batch records, databases, and other approved formats, including problems and deviations
Troubleshoot, document, and address process deviations
Write and update work instructions and other process documentation
Package finished products
Complete assigned tasks each day to keep production on schedule
Work within an ISO 13485, GMP, and Lean manufacturing environment, following applicable regulatory requirements and Lean principles

What You’ll Bring To The Team

Manufacturing Associate I

0–1 year of relevant lab experience and/or a bachelor’s or associate’s degree in biology, chemistry, biochemistry, or a related field
Ability to follow work instructions and SOPs to meet manufacturing goals
Familiarity with or prior experience in a manufacturing environment is a plus

Manufacturing Associate II

2+ years of relevant lab experience and/or a bachelor’s or associate’s degree in biology, chemistry, biochemistry, or a related field
Familiarity with or prior experience in a manufacturing environment
Intermediate knowledge of and hands-on experience with molecular biology techniques and processes

Manufacturing Associate III

4+ years of relevant lab experience and/or a bachelor’s or associate’s degree in biology, chemistry, biochemistry, or a related field
Familiarity with or prior experience in a manufacturing environment
Advanced knowledge of and hands-on experience with molecular biology techniques and processes
Ability to troubleshoot processes and escalate issues appropriately
Ability to help create procedures and administrative controls and to train operators
Advanced knowledge of Confluence

Required for all levels

Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Strong attention to detail and commitment to process consistency
Ability to work independently and safely
Strong computer skills and comfort using computers for all aspects of manufacturing, including Excel, Word, Jira/Confluence, and web-based systems

Team-based, controlled laboratory environment
Ability to stand for long periods while performing duties

Twist Bioscience synthesizes genes from scratch, known as “writing” DNA. Just as children learn to both read and write, the next phase of development for the genomics revolution is the ability to write DNA.

In fields such as health care, agriculture, industrial chemicals and data storage, our unique silicon-based DNA Synthesis Platform provides precision at a scale that is otherwise unavailable to our customers.

Founded in 1965, UC Irvine
is a member of the prestigious Association of American Universities and is ranked among the nation’s top 10 public universities by U.S. News & World Report. https://statconsulting.uci.edu/

Your Role on the Team

This position is within the Center for Statistical Consulting (CSC) in the Department of Statistics in the Donald Bren School of Information and Computer Sciences. The Center serves clients from across campus (including the social sciences, physical sciences, engineering, and biological/health sciences) as well as both non-profit and for-profit external entities. Given the nature of their positions, statisticians work closely with other scientists and research investigators, providing support for statistical, biostatistical, and epidemiology collaborative research, methodology research, and education.

Reporting directly to the Center's Director, the incumbent will conceptualize, plan, design, develop, and implement statistical models for data analysis. Additionally, they will interpret, summarize, and communicate results in writing and presenting results in research meetings, consultation, and collaborative research. The position requires designing and teaching short courses on the practice of statistics and research to diverse audiences. A successful candidate will be familiar with frequentist and Bayesian inference and can implement a variety of statistical methods (including, but not limited to, survival analysis, generalized linear models, mixed-effects models, and machine learning algorithms) for analysis of observational research, social science research, laboratory studies, clinical trials, and population-based studies. The incumbent is responsible for managing multiple collaborative research projects and associated deadlines.

The expected pay range for this position is: $92,400.00 - 111,720.00 / year

Required

What It Takes to be Successful

Thorough knowledge of research function. Research skills at a level to evaluate alternate solutions and develop recommendations. Experience with grant proposals and study design (including but not limited to sample size, power, and precision analysis). Demonstrated skill in both collaborative research and methodology research.
Thorough skills associated with statistical analysis and systems programming. Experience with statistical methods and models common in econometrics and social sciences, including fixed-effects models, latent variable analysis, and panel data analysis. Working knowledge of theoretical and applied statistics (both frequentist and Bayesian). Experience with linear and generalized linear models, linear and generalized linear mixed models, survival analysis, longitudinal and panel data, machine learning, and prediction. Strong foundational training in mathematical statistics and probability. Experience in simulation programming.
Thorough skills in analysis and consultation. Experience working with large databases and data sets. Experience writing statistical analysis plans for grant applications or research proposals. Demonstrated analytical and investigative skills to elicit information needed to clarify inquiries, requests, methods, and procedures.
Skills to communicate complex information in a clear and concise manner both verbally and in writing with a variety of research personnel and colleagues with varying technical backgrounds.
Skills in project management. Demonstrated exceptional organizational skills, including the ability to work proactively and collaboratively to manage a high volume of projects with specific deadlines. Ability to take initiative and function independently.
Research skills at a level to evaluate alternate solutions and develop recommendations.
Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training

Preferred

Proficient in at least one statistical software package such as SAS, Stata, SPSS, Python, Mplus, and/or R. Basic understanding of relational databases. Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
Professional skill in handling sensitive and confidential information, including but not limited to HIPAA-protected health data, proprietary research data, and confidential client study information.
Master's degree with a minimum of two years of experience in statistics, biostatistics, or a related quantitative field combined with equivalent coursework or experience; or a related field and four years of professional statistical experience; or an equivalent combination of education and experience, and knowledge and abilities essential to the successful performance of the duties assigned to this position.
PhD degree in statistics, biostatistics, or a related quantitative field.
A minimum of 3 years of experience

jobs.title: Senior Clinical Data Analyst
jobs.description:
POSITION TITLE:
Senior Clinical Data Analyst

REPORTS TO:
Chief Medical Information Officer

SALARY RANGE:
$85,000 - $115,000

Job Summary: The Senior Clinical Data Analyst supports the mission of Santa Rosa Community Health (SRCH), A Federally Qualified Health Center (FQHC), by transforming clinical, operational, and population health data into actionable information that improves equitable access, quality, patient outcomes, and care delivery.

This role partners clinical, quality, behavioral health, dental, enabling-services, operations, finance, and leadership teams to develop reliable reports and dashboards; monitor performance; identify care gaps and disparities; and support data-informed improvement work. The Senior Clinical Data Analyst works with a strong commitment to patient-centered, culturally responsive care for medically underserved communities.

The Senior Clinical Data Analyst works closely with the Population Health and Electronic Health Record teams as well as SRCH clinical and operational leaders to ensure high-quality usable reports that incorporate data standards and validation processes. The Senior Clinical Data Analyst will also collaborate with other community health centers to ensure consistency in data governance related activities. The Senior Clinical Data Analyst has expert knowledge of SQL, experience working with an electronic health record, and a working knowledge of health care practices, workflows, and documentation. In addition, this position requires excellent written and verbal communication skills to facilitate ongoing collaboration and ensure that reports align with agreed upon specifications from clinical and administrative report requests.

Specific Tasks/Duties Include:

Data Analysis, Reporting, and Visualization

Extract, validate, analyze, interpret, and integrate data from electronic health records, claims systems, scheduling platforms, referral systems, registries, health information exchanges, and other internal and external data sources.
Design, develop, and maintain dashboards, reports, scorecards, patient registries, data visualizations, and recurring reporting tools to support clinical, operational, financial, and population health initiatives.
Develop and maintain SQL queries, reporting logic, algorithms, and analytic processes to support organizational reporting needs.
Present findings and recommendations through reports, dashboards, presentations, and written summaries tailored to various audiences.
Maintain documentation including report specifications, data definitions, business rules, data dictionaries, workflows, and query methodology.

Quality, Population Health, and Performance Improvement

Monitor and report performance on clinical quality, population health, access, utilization, patient experience, financial, and operational measures.
Identify care gaps, variations in performance, and opportunities for improvement through data analysis.
Support patient outreach activities and population health initiatives related to preventive care, chronic disease management, referrals, and care coordination.
Analyze outcomes by demographic, geographic, language, insurance, disability, and social determinant factors to identify disparities and advance health equity initiatives.
Support quality improvement activities through baseline measurement, intervention monitoring, performance tracking, and evaluation of outcomes.
Partner with clinical and operational leaders to translate data findings into actionable workflow and process improvements.

Regulatory, Compliance, and External Reporting

Support reporting requirements for UDS, HRSA, DHCS, CDPH, Partnership HealthPlan, SAMHSA, Title X, grants, incentive programs, accreditation activities, and other regulatory or contractual obligations.
Maintain current knowledge of reporting specifications, quality metrics, value-based care programs, and external reporting requirements.
Prepare accurate and timely reports for internal leadership, regulatory agencies, grant programs, and external stakeholders.
Ensure compliance with organizational policies, HIPAA requirements, data governance standards, and applicable federal and state regulations.

Data Quality, Governance, and System Optimization

Perform routine data quality audits and validation activities to ensure reporting accuracy and data integrity.
Identify and address workflow, documentation, data entry, and system issues that impact reporting outcomes.
Collaborate with Information Technology, EHR Optimization, Population Health, and operational teams to improve data collection, system configuration, reporting processes, and workflow alignment.
Support EHR optimization initiatives by providing data analysis, validation, and performance monitoring.
Participate in organizational data governance efforts, including standardization of definitions, measures, and reporting methodologies.
Collaborate with external partners and community health center organizations as needed to promote consistency in reporting and data governance practices.

Project Planning and Stakeholder Collaboration

Collaborate with clinical, operational, and executive leaders to define business requirements, project scope, reporting specifications, deliverables, and timelines for analytical projects.
Facilitate meetings related to reporting, analytics, quality improvement, and strategic initiatives.
Assist leadership in prioritizing data requests and managing analytic work plans.
Provide project management, process design, implementation support, and ongoing monitoring for data-driven initiatives.
Support strategic planning, workforce planning, grant applications, operational planning, and community health assessment activities through data analysis and reporting.
Support reporting and analytics needs of residency, fellowship, and training programs.

Empanelment and Panel Management Analytics

Serve as a data and analytics resource to the Continuity and Empanelment Oversight Committee and operational leadership regarding patient panel management, continuity, provider capacity, and access planning.
Develop, validate, and maintain provider panel management reports, continuity metrics, panel capacity analyses, and access measures.
Assist with monthly reporting and monitoring of PCP assignment rates, panel fullness, continuity targets, urgent access metrics, and third-next-available appointment measures.
Support provider panel reassignment projects resulting from provider onboarding, departures, leave of absence, FTE changes, and organizational restructuring.
Present panel management performance data and recommendations to leadership and operational workgroups.
Support training and communication efforts related to empanelment reporting, PCP assignment standards, and continuity improvement initiatives.

Confidentiality And Professional Responsibilities

Maintain strict confidentiality of patient, employee, and organizational information.
Attend required meetings, trainings, and professional development activities.
Perform other duties as assigned in support of organizational goals and priorities.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Health Informatics, Public Health, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Statistics, Epidemiology, Engineering, Health Administration, or a related field required.
Master's degree or post-baccalaureate certification in Health Informatics, Public Health, Data Analytics, Data Science, or a related field preferred.
Must reside in California and be available for periodic travel to SRCH locations as required.
Minimum three (3) years of experience in healthcare data analysis, healthcare informatics, quality reporting, population health analytics, or a related field.
Advanced SQL experience required.
Experience working with electronic health record systems required.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills required, including pivot tables, lookups, formulas, and data analysis functions.
Experience with healthcare reporting and analytics platforms preferred.
Experience in an FQHC, community health center, public health, managed care, or hospital environment strongly preferred.
Experience supporting UDS, quality measure reporting, value-based care programs, or regulatory reporting strongly preferred.
Experience with SharePoint, data visualization tools, and dashboard development preferred.
Strong knowledge of healthcare data structures, clinical quality measures, population health management, and healthcare workflows.
Advanced proficiency in SQL, data analysis, and report development.
Ability to analyze complex datasets and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
Knowledge of healthcare quality programs, value-based care models, and regulatory reporting requirements.
Strong project management and organizational skills with ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.
Ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Knowledge of healthcare privacy, confidentiality, and information security requirements.
Demonstrated commitment to serving diverse and medically underserved populations.
Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a team environment.

SRCH is an equal opportunity employer to all, regardless of age, ancestry, color, disability (mental and physical), exercising the right to family care and medical leave, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, military or veteran status, national origin, political affiliation, race, religious creed, sex (includes pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, and related medical conditions), and sexual orientation.

Physical Requirements
:

While performing the duties of this job, this position is frequently required to do the following:

Use standard office equipment and access, input, and retrieve information from a computer.

jobs.description:
Special Instructions to Applicants

Department Summary

The UCLA Agile Visual Analytics Lab (AVAL) empowers national, state, and local stakeholders to use data to make more timely and sound decisions impacting children, families, communities, and the workforces that serve them. We do this through 1) putting vital information into the hands of stakeholders in the form of data visualizations that efficiently and effectively meet their diverse and dynamic information needs, 2) implementing utilization-focused and developmental evaluation of programs and policies of mission-driven organizations and systems, and 3) building the capacity of systems and organizations to grow, use, and sustain data ecosystems. In these ways we work with our partners in different capacities, depending on their specific needs, ranging from leading full-scale evaluations to data collection, data management and processing, and data visualization.

Position Summary

The Senior Research Associate position with the UCLA Agile Visual Analytics Lab (AVAL) is an exciting opportunity for an experienced applied researcher to contribute to the lab’s mission by taking a leading role in complex, multifaceted evaluation and research projects. The Senior Research Associate will help shape research and evaluation designs, lead the development and implementation of data collection, conduct advanced analyses, and develop and prepare a wide-range of reporting products. The position is designed for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative research environment and is ready to take greater responsibility for coordinating research activities and supporting the work of multidisciplinary teams. The role is particularly well suited for someone who enjoys combining advanced research methods, technology, and effective stakeholder engagement to help partners use data in their work. This position will collaborate directly with stakeholders to identify information needs, interpret findings, develop relevant recommendations, and build their capacity to use data and research findings. The position also provides opportunities to coordinate workflows and provide feedback to Research Associates and other members of the research team. The ideal candidate is a highly organized and intellectually curious applied research professional with advanced qualitative and quantitative research skills, substantial experience with data collection, management, and analysis, and excellent written and verbal communication abilities. Successful candidates will be able to independently navigate complex research activities while collaborating effectively across multidisciplinary teams and with a wide range of stakeholders. Advanced knowledge of utilization-focused evaluation, participatory research, human services systems, and visual design principles for communicating data in a clear, accurate, engaging, and equity-aware manner will be especially valuable.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Your Role

The Clinical Quality team is accountable for the quality ratings of the organization, for improving preventive and primary care outcomes for Blue Shield of California’s Commercial members and for managing financial risks associated with Quality performance. The Health Data Analyst for Clinical Quality (Principal) will report to the Senior Director of Clinical Quality. In this role, you will serve as the primary analytics advisor to Clinical Quality leadership and Commercial Quality teams, providing advanced forecasting, performance modeling, and decision support to drive quality ratings, enterprise strategy, financial planning, and investment decisions. You will develop forecasts for quality improvement interventions, establish measure-level performance targets, and lead complex, cross-functional analyses across Commercial lines of business and statewide provider networks.

You will develop data models and recommendations informed by NCQA ratings, HEDIS, and CAHPS measures, and partner across the organization to apply predictive modeling to preventive and primary care patterns. You will also serve as a strategic advisor on the integration of AI tools and methodologies into quality operations, analytics, and forecasting.

Our leadership model is about developing great leaders at all levels and creating opportunities for our people to grow – personally, professionally, and financially. We are looking for leaders that are energized by creative and critical thinking, building and sustaining high-performing teams, getting results the right way, and fostering continuous learning.

Responsibilities

Your Work

In this role, you will:

Serve as the lead architect for Clinical Quality forecasting, simulation, and decision-support methodologies.
Design and maintain forecasting methodologies and measure level target setting for HEDIS, CAHPS, Stars, and quality performance metrics using predictive analytics, statistical modeling, sensitivity testing, and scenario planning methodologies
Translate executive questions and strategic priorities into analytical frameworks, predictive models, and actionable recommendations.
Partner with senior leadership and analytics teams to evaluate strategic options through quantitative modeling and evidence-based decision making.
Develop scalable analytical tools and self-service dashboards that accelerate decision making across Clinical Quality and enterprise partners.
Develop executive decision-support models quantifying the operational, quality, financial, and member experience impacts of alternative strategic investments, interventions, and network strategies
Develop and conduct evaluations and studies within limited time frames and produce analyses that are easy for non-technical persons to understand
Apply advanced statistical methods, advanced analytics and modeling techniques, visualization techniques, and advanced programming to innovate our products and services
Design and maintain complex forecasting models utilizing Excel, Databricks, SQL, Tableau, and emerging AI-enabled analytics platforms
Work with cross-functional partners to engineer new analytics that improve member satisfaction and access to preventive care; estimate the resources needed and provide planning and support for innovation
Manipulate large, structured and unstructured data sets to develop quality ratings and operational insights for Senior/Executive Management review
Create forecasts using new/emerging data sets relying on input from a variety of public health and research inputs and build new analytic bridges between claims, encounter and supplemental data sources
Work cross-functionally with utilization, pharmacy, transformation, quality, product and other cross-functional teams to support root cause analysis, quantitative data analysis and interpretation, annual strategic planning, and return-on-investment (ROI) calculations
Ensure compliance with regulatory, purchaser and accreditation requirements to provide the most equitable preventive care and services offered in the market

Qualifications

Your Knowledge and Experience

Requires a Bachelors degree or High School Diploma, GED and 4 years of additional relevant experience in lieu of a degree
Prefers an MPH, MBA, MS, MA in science, social science, public health, health svcs research or business
Requires at least 10 years’ experience in Health Care (managed care, academic, or gov’t payer), strategic consulting or Healthcare economics
Requires demonstrated success delivering executive storytelling with data
Requires demonstrated experience developing sophisticated forecasting, simulation, scenario planning and decision-support models using Excel, SQL, Databricks, Tableau, or equivalent analytical platforms.
Requires at least 5 years of demonstrated experience developing large-scale data analysis and visualization design in support of clinical care improvements
Requires at least 3 years of demonstrated experience with HEDIS and/or CAHPS measurement, forecasting, and improvement, or similar Quality Improvement ratings systems, as well as successful participation in annual financial modeling, resource negotiation and operational planning in environments of rapid execution; strategic planning as well as experience working with large healthcare claims, encounters, laboratory, pharmacy, provider, member, and supplemental data sets
Demonstrated experience creating population forecast models for the improvement of primary or outpatient care workflows preferred
Prefers demonstrated experience supporting and influencing clinical change management efforts with the ability to communicate complex ideas simply and succinctly both verbally and in writing, including ability to speak comfortably and extemporaneously to diverse audiences, capable of self-management and inspiring others to take action through influence and relationship building

Employees living more than 50 miles from an office location will work with their manager to determine in-office time based on business need.

jobs.description:
Special Instructions to Applicants

To be considered for this position, applicants must submit a resume, cover letter, and a list of references. Please have these documents ready for upload when completing your application. You may combine your cover letter and list of references into a single file and copy and paste it into the “Cover Letter” section.

Department Summary

The UCLA Department of Psychology is an exceptional department known for its excellence in research, teaching, and service. With a distinguished faculty comprising more than 60 ladder rank members, it is one of the nation's top psychology departments. Its undergraduate program is the largest within the Division of Life Sciences and the UCLA College, with 5000 undergraduate students enrolled across three majors: Psychology, Psychobiology, and Cognitive Science. The department also offers a comprehensive Ph.D. program with eight areas of study toapproximately 200 enrolled graduate students.

Position Summary

A reliable, highly organized, and independent individual is sought for a full-time Staff Research Associate (SRA) Position in the Brain and Body Lab (BABLab) and Social Affective Neuroscience and Development Lab (SAND Lab), in the UCLA Department of Psychology, under the joint supervision of the Principal Investigators Dr. Bridget Callaghan and Dr. Jennifer Silvers. The SRA will be responsible for coordinating and conducting a research study on the effects of education and stress on brain health. The BABLab and SAND Labs study how early experiences shape physical and mental health outcomes. We utilize behavioral, fMRI, and health-related measures (e.g., microbiome and inflammation) to better understand phenomena related to stress, brain function, cognition, and emotion. The role of the SRA will involve implementing experiments, programming experimental tasks and questionnaire data collection software, recruiting and scheduling participants, running research sessions, and analyzing data. The SRA will also play an integral role in overseeing day-to-day study operations, which includes maintaining research equipment, overseeing IRB protocols, planning and scheduling events and research meetings, maintaining and analyzing data, and helping to supervise undergraduate research assistants. In addition to supporting the lab's functioning, the ideal SRA will have an opportunity to contribute creatively to research projects, work closely and productively with other lab members, and coauthor academic papers and poster presentations.

Salary & Compensation

UCLA provides a full pay range. Actual salary offers consider factors, including budget, prior experience, skills, knowledge, abilities, education, licensure and certifications, and other business considerations. Salary offers at the top of the range are not common. Visit UC Benefit package to discover benefits that start on day one, and UC Total Compensation Estimator to calculate the total compensation value with benefits.

Qualifications

Statistical background and basic competence in statistical programming (R, SPSS).Programming skills in at least one language (e.g. R, Python, MATLAB).Demonstrated ability to maintain professionalism and good decision making when confronted with difficult people or situations. (Required)
Demonstrated ability to handle confidential materials with discretion. (Required)
Experience with neuroimaging data acquisition and analysis, particularly FSL. (Preferred)
Prior interest in, or experience with, working with developmental, or psychiatric, or special population groups. (Preferred)
Knowledge of payment processing systems. (Cash-net and PCI).Knowledge of forms and submission procedures to obtain research approval from the UCLA Institutional Review Board and Office for the Protection of Human Subjects.Spanish bilingual. (Preferred)
Ability to use standard office equipment, including multi-line telephones, recording equipment, and scanners. (Required)
MRI scanner operation. MRI preprocessing and analysis. (Preferred)
Excellent interpersonal skills for interacting with study participants as well as with other laboratory members. (Required)
Excellent oral and written communication skills for communicating with research participants, representing the lab publicly, as well as when writing (e.g., updating the website, IRBs, scientific publications). (Required)
Excellent organization skills and attention to detail required for adherence to study protocols, managing the lab, maintaining research equipment, curating database. (Required)
Strong prior research experience in a lab setting within Psychology or related field.Strong general computing skills (e.g., Microsoft Office Suite) in both Mac and PC).Understanding of lab research methods. (Required)
Ability to effectively prioritize, multitask, and manage co-occurring deadlines, projects, and team members, and to display adaptive and responsive decision making and problem-solving skills. (Required)

jobs.description:
Job Description

If you know how to turn SAP's partner ecosystem into a driver of AI-powered customer outcomes — building AI readiness, trusted relationships, and measurable adoption at scale — this role was written for you. SAP's partner network is one of the most extensive in enterprise technology, and the partners within it need expert guidance to adopt AI, grow cloud usage, and reduce renewal risk. Your job is to own a partner portfolio, drive AI adoption and cloud growth, and deliver the commercial outcomes that create real value for customers. With a global network of partners building AI expertise across every industry and region, the scale and impact of what you will be shaping is unlike most roles in enterprise technology right now.

You have solid experience in partner or customer success and understand how AI drives business value. You work independently, own a portfolio against clear targets, and lead outcomes without close direction.

What You'll Bring

Experience in customer success, partner success, or cloud-adoption roles — ideally enabling CSM teams at partner organizations to support indirect cloud adoption and manage renewal risk
Ability to drive measurable customer success and adoption outcomes through structured partner engagement (this is not a training-curriculum design or delivery role)
Demonstrated hands-on expertise applying agentic AI, context engineering, and AI-assisted automation to real adoption use cases — able to advise partners on AI value realization and output-quality assurance (this is an AI-specialist role)
Data-driven approach to tracking adoption metrics, active usage, renewal rate, and forecast cadences
Degree not required.

We also look for people who build trust naturally, communicate with clarity, keep the customer at the center of what they do, and bring emotional intelligence and genuine problem-solving ability to the challenges they face.

This is a partner customer-success and AI-adoption role focused on driving cloud adoption, renewal, and measurable AI value across an assigned partner portfolio. It is distinct from partner-enablement and training-delivery roles: the emphasis here is on adoption outcomes and commercial results, not on designing or delivering partner training curricula.

In addition to the skills and experience specific to this role, all positions at SAP require candidates who are comfortable using AI tools — including agentic AI — in their day-to-day work, from crafting effective inputs and automating routine tasks, to evaluating AI-generated outputs for quality and driving adoption of AI practices within their teams.

Drive measurable AI-capability adoption across your portfolio by setting adoption plans, running value reviews, and advising partners on embedding SAP AI into their customer delivery — without owning training curriculum design or delivery
Collaborate with CSM teams at SAP PartnerEdge Sell partners to drive cloud adoption and expand SAP's footprint
Carry and report against a defined cloud subscription and renewal target for your portfolio, including quarterly forecast commitments and renewal-risk mitigation plans
Own portfolio-level KPIs — AI adoption rate, active usage, renewal rate, and net cloud subscription growth — reported through a monthly forecast cadence
Foster partner self-sufficiency in AI workflows and output quality assurance practices

The Success Plan Manager team helps partners unlock the value of AI for their customers. This position supports institutional research, student success analytics, college accountability, and institutional reporting within the Office of Decision Support. Responsibilities include statistical analysis, data integration and modeling, and development of dashboards and reports to support institutional planning and decision-making.

Duties include use of specific statistical analysis software such as SAS or SPSS and may include SQL or other programming. This position may act as a data consultant to several research studies.

Responsibilities

Develops analytical plans for institutional research projects by determining data requirements, identifying appropriate data sources, and selecting statistical methods and analytical procedures.
Conducts statistical analyses of institutional data using SAS, SQL, and other analytical tools. Examines student enrollment, progression, retention, graduation, and other institutional outcomes. Develops, evaluates, and refines statistical and predictive models in consultation with project leads.
Summarizes and communicates analytical results through graphs, tables, charts, and interactive Power Bl dashboards. Develops and maintains Power Bl and Excel reports, including supporting data models and calculations, and explains findings and limitations to technical and nontechnical audiences.
Designs recurring and ad hoc reports and analyses requested by administrators. Supports the College Accountability Framework, college scorecards, Accountability Plan, Performance-Based Funding metrics, and other institutional reporting needs, including comparisons with peer institutions.
Collaborates with team members and institutional partners to clarify research questions and reporting requirements, select appropriate statistical Designs, develops, and maintains analytical datasets, database tables, and views using SQL, SAS, and Microsoft SQL Server. Develops and automates extract, transform, and load (ETL) processes to integrate data from multiple sources and support analysis and reporting. Works with systems programmers and data owners as needed.
Validates data, programs, analyses, and reports for accuracy and consistency. Documents data sources, methodologies, business rules, and technical processes to support reproducibility and continuity.
Performs other duties as assigned.

This position requires a Bachelor's degree in a field directly related to the research or data analysis responsibilities and a minimum of one year of research experience; or a Master's degree in one of the same fields. Progressively responsible work experience may substitute for the college on a year for year basis.

Job Description

The Department of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences at Stanford University School of Medicine

is seeking a highly motivated Life Science Research Professional 2 to join Dr. Sergiu Pasca’s research program in a 1-year fixed term role.

Our Stanford research team seeks to understand the rules that govern the molecular and cellular steps underlying the assembly of the human brain and the molecular mechanisms that lead to neurodevelopmental and neurodegenerative disorders. The UC Irvine Institute for Memory Impairments and Neurological Disorders (UCI MIND) Orange County's only state and federally funded Alzheimer's Disease Research Center and is internationally recognized for its research accomplishments in age-related brain disorders. The Institute is composed of faculty and staff from multiple Departments and Schools, ranging from basic laboratory scientists to physician investigators, with a common goal of research discovery to improve the diagnosis, treatment, prevention, and cure of age-related brain diseases, especially Alzheimer's disease.

For more than 30 years, UCI MIND has been at the forefront of Alzheimer's disease research. It is home to one of 37 Alzheimer's Disease Research Centers (ADRC) funded by the National Institute on Aging (NIA), a branch of the National Institutes of Health (NIH), and one of 10 California Alzheimer's Disease Centers funded by the California Department of Public Health.

To learn more about UCI MIND, visit mind.uci.edu.
